extensionDescription.message: Keep selected URL entries, clean configured hostnames, and browse History statistics.

toolbarUnsupported.message: This page cannot be protected. Open an HTTP or HTTPS website.

toolbarMatchedEntryOnly.message: Matched: history is kept only for the entry point:

errorInvalidUrl.message: Enter a valid full http:// or https:// URL.

errorPaging.message: Could not safely paginate History results.

errorCleanLimit.message: Too many results for one cleanup. Run Clean Now again.

popupSubtitle.message: Click once to protect or inspect the current URL

popupNoTab.message: No active tab was found. Open a website and try again.

popupUnsupported.message: This page cannot be protected. Open an HTTP or HTTPS website.

popupMatchedAll.message: ✓ Matches a protected rule — History retained

popupMatchedEntryOnly.message: ✓ Matches a protected rule — entry point only

popupHint.message: Only configured hosts are cleaned. No History takes priority over Host Entry, then Protected URLs. All other sites stay untouched.

optionsDescription.message: Manage only the hosts and URL entries you specify. All other sites remain untouched.

howStep1.message: Use the toolbar to protect the current URL, or add Protected URL, Host Entry, or No History rules in Options.

howStep2.message: No History deletes all matching visits. Keep Host Entry Only retains one URL and removes other visits on that hostname or its selected subdomains. Protected URL rules work as before.

addDescription.message: Enter a complete URL and choose how it should match. Query strings and fragments are excluded from saved entry points.

helpExact.message: Exact matches only the saved path. Only its canonical entry URL is kept in History.

helpPrefix.message: Prefix matches the path and descendants (e.g. /g/ also matches /g/abc, but not /games).

helpEntry.message: Save the entry URL; automatically delete descendant History.

helpAll.message: Keep every matching descendant URL in Firefox History.

addExists.message: This path is already protected. Edit the existing rule below:

listEmpty.message: No protected URLs yet. Use the toolbar icon or the form above.

listHelp.message: Each URL has its own rule. Removing a rule does not immediately erase History. Removing the last rule for a host stops cleanup on that host.

removeConfirm.message: Remove protection for this URL? History is not deleted immediately:

cleanDescription.message: Remove unprotected URL records under configured Protected URL hosts, remove all but the saved Host Entry URL for configured hostname scopes, and delete all No History matches. Unrelated hosts remain untouched. Cannot be undone.

cleanDetails.message: Bookmarks, cookies and downloads are not removed.

cleanEmpty.message: No Protected URL, Host Entry, or No History rules. Nothing to clean.

cleanConfirm.message: Clean the configured hosts now? Only selected hosts will be affected. No History takes priority over Host Entry and Protected URL rules. This cannot be undone.

cleanProgress.message: Cleaning configured-host History… Keep this page open.

cleanFailure.message: Some URL records could not be deleted:

footer.message: Firefox writes visits before extensions can remove them. No History means prompt deletion, not prevention of writing.

toolbarExcluded.message: No History — automatically delete visits on:

errorInvalidHostname.message: Enter a valid hostname without a path, port, wildcard or credentials.

popupExcluded.message: × No History — visits will be deleted

excludeDescription.message: Delete all History on a hostname, optionally including every level of subdomain. Even saved Protected URL entries are not retained. Existing visits are removed with Clean Now.

excludeHelp.message: An excluded hostname takes precedence over Protected URLs. Turn subdomains on or off per rule. Removing an exclusion does not restore previously deleted browsing History.

excludeConflictConfirm.message: This No History rule matches protected entry points listed below. Those entries will no longer be retained and Clean Now will delete their History. Continue?

excludeExists.message: Hostname already has a No History rule. Edit the existing entry:

excludeRemoveConfirm.message: Remove No History for this hostname? New visits will no longer be deleted by this rule:

excludeError.message: Unable to save No History rule:

toolbarHostEntryClean.message: Host Entry rule: History is cleared for:

popupHostEntryClean.message: × Host matched — only the entry URL is retained

hostEntryDescription.message: Keep exactly one entry URL. Remove other History on this hostname and, optionally, all its subdomains. No History still takes priority.

hostEntryOptionalUrl.message: Leave blank to keep the HTTPS homepage of this hostname.

hostEntryExists.message: Hostname already has a Host Entry rule. Edit it below:

hostEntryError.message: Unable to save Host Entry rule:

hostEntryRemoveConfirm.message: Remove this Host Entry rule? Previously deleted History is not restored:

hostEntryConflictConfirm.message: This Host Entry rule overlaps existing rules. No History always takes priority. Protected URLs under this host may be cleared. Continue?

errorInvalidHostEntry.message: Entry URL must be an HTTP(S) URL within the selected hostname scope.

backupDescription.message: Export a local JSON backup of rules only (not browsing History). Imported settings can contain sensitive saved URLs. Import does not run Clean Now.

importTooLarge.message: Settings file or rule set is too large.

importInvalid.message: Invalid or inconsistent settings file. Nothing was imported.

importReplaceConfirm.message: Replace ALL existing rules with the selected file? This cannot be undone. Export a backup first.

importMergeConfirm.message: Merge rules from this file? Existing duplicates will remain unchanged.

explorerDescription.message: Inspect existing Firefox History. Filter URL/hostname, rank hostnames and select a hostname to view its URL list.

explorerNotes.message: Statistics reflect only History entries that still exist. Automatically deleted records are not available. Scan again after cleanup to refresh.

explorerReady.message: Select Analyze History to scan all stored History.

explorerCancelled.message: Scan cancelled. Previous results, if any, remain visible.

explorerError.message: Unable to complete full History scan:

explorerTooLarge.message: History is too large to count completely without risking truncated results. No partial result will be shown.

explorerMinUrlsHelp.message: Hide hosts with fewer distinct URLs than this value. Filtering affects the list only; it never deletes History.

explorerNoHosts.message: No hosts match the current filters.

statsDescription.message: Daily totals for successfully completed automatic and Clean Now deletion calls.

statsNotes.message: Counts represent completed URL deletion calls, not visits or necessarily unique URLs. Repeated calls on the same URL may be counted again. Dates use the local calendar day when deleted. Only date/count aggregates are stored; earlier deletions cannot be reconstructed.

fullBackupTitle.message: Full Backup — Rules and Daily Statistics

fullBackupDescription.message: Use Full Backup before replacing a temporary debugging add-on with a signed AMO installation. The local JSON file includes private saved URLs and daily deletion counts. Keep it secure. Restoring replaces all rules and daily statistics, but does not run Clean Now.

fullBackupChoose.message: Select a full backup JSON file

fullBackupExportSuccess.message: Full backup download started. Verify the JSON file before removing the debugging add-on.

fullBackupRestoreConfirm.message: Replace ALL rules and daily statistics with this full backup? This cannot be undone. Keep a copy of the current settings first.

fullBackupRestoreSuccess.message: Full backup restored (Protected / No History / Host Entry / Statistics days):

fullBackupInvalid.message: Invalid full backup file, version, or extension ID. Nothing was restored.

fullBackupTooLarge.message: The full backup file is too large.
